verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a hosted model API, so the axis applies. Morph's docs in the pack never describe retention settings, deletion endpoints, or zero-retention options. The only related item is a community quote of the privacy policy, which differentiates model-training use by tier (free tier may be trained on; enterprise tier is not). That is an adjacent training-use policy, not a user-controllable retention or deletion capability, so it earns no credit here.
